why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check that you're allowed in. The terms ban residents of the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, China, North Korea, Russia, Ukraine, Cuba, Iran, Venezuela and Syria, and the risk disclosure prohibits using a VPN to get around the block.

Join the RWAPerp waitlist , which is free. Connect your X account, follow @RWAPerp, connect a wallet by signing a message that costs no gas, and do the smaller tasks. You can link up to three wallets.
Wait for access. RWAPerp admits users in batches by XP rank and says it tells you through X, the waitlist page or email. An invite code from someone already inside also works.
Set up a wallet for X Layer. The docs recommend OKX Wallet. In MetaMask, add the network yourself: Network name: X Layer Mainnet
Get USDC and a little OKB onto X Layer. The docs point to OKX's bridge . Without OKB you can't send transactions.

Open app.rwaperp.xyz , connect the wallet, accept the terms and sign to create your trading account. Then deposit USDC. Warning This is real money with up to 20x leverage on stocks. The docs say: "You may lose all deposited collateral."
costs: The waitlist is free. RWAPerp doesn't publish its trading fees: the terms refer to a fee schedule that isn't in the docs. Funding is paid between long and short traders every one, four or eight hours, depending on the market. The exchange's public data listed a 1 USDC withdrawal fee and a 10 USDC minimum order when we checked. Gas on X Layer is paid in OKB. Leaving X Layer through the official bri
risks: Points have no stated payoff, and RWAPerp can change the rules. Wash trading, self-trading and linked accounts may be excluded. No audit report is published. RWAPerp's own risk disclosure calls the protocol "experimental software". The waitlist doesn't guarantee access, and a slot you don't use in time can go to someone else.
